# `foxglove episodes`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](README.md)

```text
List and manage episodes

Usage: foxglove episodes [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Create an episode, or get the existing one with the same window and recordings
  delete  Delete an episode
  get     Get an episode
  list    List episodes
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
